idea-plugin.name: Semantic Programming Language Syntax Highlighting
idea-plugin.description:
Semantic Programming Language for JetBrains

High-quality editor support for the Semantic Programming Language in JetBrains IDEs.

Semantic Programming Language is a universal, matrix-driven programming language and compiler architecture based on canonical SemanticProgram / Universal Abstract Syntax Tree (UAST) representations.

This plugin focuses on fast, lightweight language support for readable Semantic source files and integrates .se and .sp files directly into IntelliJ Platform editors.

Features

  • Syntax highlighting for .se and .sp
  • Semantic keyword and constant highlighting
  • Strings, numbers and Semantic references
  • # line comments
  • Semantic operators and delimiters
  • JetBrains file-type integration
  • Semantic file and plugin icons

Semantic source

se 1

# Semantic Programming Language
program Demo
object Main

scope example {
    node item
    relations

    true
    %12
    @42
    "Hello Semantic"
    123
}

About Semantic

The broader Semantic architecture represents programs independently of their original source language. Source code can be lowered into a canonical SemanticProgram/UAST representation and processed through shared validation, transformation, transpilation and compiler stages.

Publisher: Tarek Wasfy

Website: https://www.semantic-programming-language.com/

GitHub: https://github.com/SemanticProgrammingLanguage/Semantic-Programming-Language-for-JetBrains
